description: Every commit in a pull-request range carries a strict stage prefix (DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW:, TEST:, FINALISE:) and the separation audit judges the paths it touches against that stage's file classes, the role derived from the stage. Builder hygiene tests have their own builder-owned class outside the RCF suite. FINALISE: carries only a merge from main, lockfiles, declared-generator outputs named by Generated-By:, chain status records, release evidence and the release cut. Merges are judged by their resolution. Hand: mixed and --require-hand retire. During the transition a Hand: trailer that agrees with the derived role is accepted and one that disagrees fails.
rationale: Operator rulings 10:40Z Q-01 a and Q-02 with its refinements (redesign :146-151), D-12 and D-13 as amended in the DEFINE spec, D-14 (audit section 5). Today the trailer is the marker (src/audit/separation.js:264-267), test directories are test-author only (:127), merges are skipped (:273-274) and Hand: mixed is the routine chore escape (:152-155, register WA-04).
title: rcf audit separation judges each commit by its stage prefix against per-stage file classes, replacing the Hand trailer
